title: Milestone-snapshot runbook and release-notes ownership flow for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a concise, executable runbook that drives consistent milestone snapshots, scope-lock heuristics, and a single source of truth for release notes ownership across API, Console, and Runtime teams. Outcome should reduce late-scope churn, make cut decisions deterministic, and deliver a coordinated release-notes PR cadence for marketing, docs, SDKs, and support.
milestones: Milestone 0 - Alignment: 2026-03-16 - Owners: PM + Eng Leads - Goal: confirm release candidate features, blockers, and critical regressions
Milestone 1 - Feature Freeze: 2026-03-23 - Owners: Team Leads - Goal: freeze new user-facing scope; only critical fixes allowed
Milestone 2 - Integration Smoke: 2026-03-30 - Owners: Eng QA + Infra - Goal: all major integration tests pass; KV/cache/serving smoke validated
Milestone 3 - Docs & Notes Draft: 2026-03-31 - Owners: Docs + PM - Goal: draft release notes, highlight migration guidance and breaking changes
Milestone 4 - Final Cut Window: 2026-04-01 - Owners: PM - Goal: final cut decision and sign-off for release candidates
cut_criteria_summary: Cut decisions use a deterministic heuristic: (1) regression severity >= P0 OR feature-blocking bug -> block release; (2) Unresolved infra SLO risk > 5% chance of violating customer SLOs -> block; (3) Non-critical UI/UX polish or TODOs -> defer to next minor if >2 workdays remaining; (4) Any new feature without a migration plan for public API endpoints -> defer. Exceptions require written cross-team sign-off and published rollback plan.
release_notes_flow: Ownership: PM drafts the primary notes and user-impact bullets. Docs team expands with examples. Engineering provides technical changelog entries (PR links) into the shared notes doc by Milestone 3. Marketing receives first draft at Milestone 3 for customer-facing headlines. Process: create release-notes branch in docs repo -> open 'release-notes' PR with checklist -> tag stakeholders (docs, marketing, SDK owners, support). Final PR merged only after sign-off checklist completed; target merge at Final Cut Window.
